name: rxjs
description: Reactive extensions for the Web Platform Observable
author: Ben Lesh <ben@benlesh.com>

scripts.test:unit: pnpm run test:installations && vitest --run src && pnpm run test:unit:cold && pnpm run test:unit:polyfill
scripts.test:imports: node test/import/esm.mjs && node test/import/commonjs.cjs && node test/import/fixtures.mjs && node test/import/bundler.mjs
scripts.test:kernel: pnpm --filter @rxjs/observable-polyfill build && pnpm run build && node test/kernel/run.mjs
scripts.test:package: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:functional-surface && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:migration-contracts && pnpm run test:installations && pnpm run test:imports
scripts.test:migration-contracts: pnpm run test:unit:report && pnpm run test:unit:parity:check && pnpm run test:unit:ledger:check && pnpm run test:unit:unsupported:check
